tools.name: extract_website_content
tools.description: Fetch web pages and return clean readable text (boilerplate, nav and ads stripped), title, description, word count and language. Deterministic, no AI, no browser. Runs Apify Actor skilled_glee/website-content-extractor on YOUR Apify account (pay-per-event $0.002646/page, billed by Apify).

tools.name: extract_web_metadata
tools.description: Extract title, meta description, Open Graph, Twitter Card, JSON-LD structured data, canonical URL, language and H1s from web pages as JSON. Runs Apify Actor skilled_glee/web-metadata-extractor on YOUR Apify account (pay-per-event $0.001/page, billed by Apify).

tools.name: extract_article
tools.description: Extract structured article data: title, author, published date, clean body text, word count and content hash. Failed URLs are not billed. Runs Apify Actor skilled_glee/article-text-extractor on YOUR Apify account (pay-per-event $0.001/article, billed by Apify).

tools.name: extract_contact_details
tools.description: Extract emails (incl. mailto), North American phone numbers, LinkedIn/X/Facebook/Instagram/YouTube links and contact/about/team page links from web pages. Runs Apify Actor skilled_glee/contact-details-extractor on YOUR Apify account (pay-per-event $0.0015/page, billed by Apify).

tools.name: verify_emails
tools.description: Check email addresses without sending mail: syntax, MX, null MX, disposable domains, role accounts, free providers and common typos, with a pass/risky/fail verdict and reason codes. Runs Apify Actor skilled_glee/email-verifier on YOUR Apify account (pay-per-event $0.001/email, billed by Apify).

tools.name: probe_urls
tools.description: Check URLs with HEAD or GET: HTTP status, final URL after redirects, redirect count, Content-Type and timing. No page body is read. Runs Apify Actor skilled_glee/http-url-probe on YOUR Apify account (pay-per-event $0.0004/URL, billed by Apify).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: extract_website_content, extract_web_metadata, verify_emails, probe_urls · Private data: extract_contact_details · Public sink: verify_emails.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: extract_website_content, extract_web_metadata, verify_emails, probe_urls · Private data: extract_contact_details · Public sink: verify_emails

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
